sermon.title: Ancient of Days Part 2
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: The little horn makes war with the saints, but no one can stop God’s hand. Judgment is given and the saints possess the kingdom with signs and wonders, rejoicing in opposition. They prevail over the boastful horns; we are delivered into His everlasting kingdom and must speak.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

chunks.section_question: What does the little horn do?
chunks.short_answer: Makes war with the saints—speaking to present and future believers; none can stay God’s hand.
chunks.text:
Let’s look at this little horn making war with the saints. Remember in Daniel 4:35, all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed or recognized as nothing. Now, you can’t get much a littler than that. No matter how great a human being you are on the earth, when it comes to God, you’re nothing. You can’t change anything. You can’t You know, only God can do these things. How many of you know, all of a sudden we’re pretty little. Even if you’re a prophet can see the destruction of the Russian nation and the tearing down of the iron curtain, you’re still when it comes to God. Reputed as nothing. So, are we little in God’s eye? Now, Matthew 24:9.

Speaking to the believers. Speaking to the future generation of believers and the present generation. They’ll deliver you up to be afflicted. They’ll kill you. You’ll be hated of all nations for my name’s sake. Then shall many be offended, betray one another, and hate one another. Many false prophets shall rise and deceive many because iniquity shall abound. Iniquity. Lawlessness. The love of many shall wax cold. Love doing no harm to its neighbor. The fulfilling of the whole word of God is loving your neighbor as yourself. How many of you know, the church is filled with iniquity? I mean, people are shacking up, coming to church, and worshiping God like they done nothing wrong.

And that’s what Proverbs says, the adulterous wipes her mouth, said, “I’ve done nothing wrong.” They’re getting drunk just like the heathen. They listen to the music that the world listens to. They They read the books that the world read. They They’re just believers. That’s it. Iniquity. Love of many shall wax cold, but he that endures to the end shall be saved. This Gospel of the Kingdom will be preached into all the world for a what? Witness. A proof. And what’s the proof here? That his saints overcome the little horn. I know us Pentecostals like to say it’s healings and signs and wonders.

Folks, that comes with the package. But that’s not the only sign. Remember Daniel showed us the signs and wonders was he is able to humble those that walk in pride. And it plainly says, “I’m going to show you the signs and wonders of God. That God is able to come and humble us. Be involved in our life. Who walk in pride. Now, how many of you know that’s going to be a tremendous sign to this world? Hallelujah. Are you here today? That’s a witness. The witness is people are living for God. Hallelujah. They’re possessing the Kingdom of righteousness, peace, and joy, and power in the Holy Ghost.

They’re possessing it. That’s the witness. And he gives signs and wonders healings, miracles along the way. But the real sign and wonder is the church walking in righteousness. Standing up for it, even if you’re not walking in it yet. Don’t let these liberals put a guilt trip on you. I can believe things that I have not entered into yet. I don’t have a right to say it’s a lie because I haven’t experienced it. Do I? And folks, until we keep growing in God, the path of the just is as a shining light that grows brighter and brighter till the perfect mature day. The Bible says. And so we are growing in righteousness, but we’re standing for right that we’re not even walking into so.

Don’t let them put a guilt trip on you. That you can’t believe higher than your life experiences walking. Can I hear an amen? We’re pursuing a goal. And then he says, “When you see the abomination of desolation spoken by Daniel the prophet.” Just threw it in right there. All right? Now, Matthew 5:10, “Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness’ sake.” So is the church, as Christian people, going to go through some difficulties? According to the Sermon on the Mount, the Beatitudes, yeah. But it’s not for being bad. You should be persecuted for what? Being right, walking in truth. Theirs is the kingdom of heaven. So what’s one of the ways we enter into the kingdom of heaven? By standing for right, and these little horns speaking great things, and and you know, ruling over us for a while, prevailing over us until God says, “Okay.

They’ve passed the judgment test. I’m giving them the kingdom.” Yeah. But are you when men shall revile you. That means speak arrogantly toward you, persecute you, and say all manner of evil against you falsely. Not truthfully. If you’re an adulterer, you’re an adulterer. Yeah. If you got a temper, you got a temper. Man, don’t be feeling sorry for yourself because people are saying, “Man, that person got a temper. That person shoots their mouth off all the time.” Well, they’re telling the truth. But when they say these things and you’re innocent, rejoice and be exceedingly glad because they did that to the prophets which were before you. Rejoice and be exceedingly glad.

Many of American Christians are like that.

Now, that was good. See, we think the little horns are just out there. Huh, you got them right in the church. Family.

You think yourself more than you have the authority to back up and the fruit to produce. That’s arrogance. They speak great words of emptiness, they allure through the lust of the flesh the ones who have actually escaped from those who live in error. They actually convince some people that have been cleansed by the blood, saved by Jesus Christ, born again to believe their lies. Do we have that in America? Yes. Absolutely. And they go on like they’re still Christians. He’s these little horns. Speaking against the word of God. While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the slaves of corruption.

Oh, man, I’m mature now. I used to I I used to be under that and had to go to church and I read my Bible, but I’m mature now. I have freedom. I don’t have I’m not under bondage to that. Refute it as nothing when you go against the word of God. And when you believe these little horns speaking, you’re going to be deceived and led away and not inherit the kingdom. Jude talks about it.

These dreamers, they defile the flesh, they reject authority, and they speak evil of dignataries. There’s that word again. They speak evil of whatever they do not know. They are spots in your love feast while they feast with you without fear. They take communion in the church, and yet they go out and live sinful lives. And they’re great quoters of faith and grace. See, what we’re saying is Jesus can only give us eternal life. He cannot He does not have the power to cause us to possess the kingdom and live for him here. And if Jesus only has the authority and power to give me eternal life and not be a blessing to my family, a blessing to my kids by loving them here on earth, he’s a worthless God because I’m here for 70 80 years.

If he’s only good in the eternities, he’s worthless to me now. And that’s what all the religions of the world do. They give you a future promise and no power now. God gives you a future promise and power now. Amen. And then he quotes Enoch in verse 15. God comes, Enoch said, “God comes to judge all harsh things ungodly sinners have spoken against him.” Whoa. These are grumblers, complainers, walking in their own lusts. In the American church, just a bunch of grumblers and complainers and blamers, attackers? We are. chunks.short_answer: Yes—over the mouthy horns; His kingdom is everlasting.
chunks.text:
We can’t overcome a flaw in anybody. Well, that Michael, yeah, he’s a good kid, but but he’s got this problem. What are we? When we do that, we are what? The little horn. Speaking against God’s things. Folks, we’re on our way to being mature. Relax a little. Can I hear an amen? We’re shining brighter and brighter every day. That means we haven’t reached the perfect brightness, the maturity yet. They speak great swelling words. Proud for words, they flatter people to gain advantage.

The apostles told you there would be mockers in the last day and last time, walking according to their own ungodly lust. The apostles told you this, Jude said. These are sensual people who cause divisions, not having the spirit. I mean, oh, Paul says there is one God, one Lord, one baptism, one body of Christ, one church. Why are we dividing it all up into Baptist and Presbyterian and Methodist? Why? What is the matter with us? Because we don’t get into this book and read it for ourself. And let God, who is the only one can open our understanding. All right.

Judgment was given to the saints, and they had dominion over the little horn, over these little talkers. Judgment, they came to possess the kingdom. You may want to raise your hands and say, “God, I want to possess the kingdom of righteousness be. They that do right are right, the Bible says. I want I want to progress. I’m glad that I can live with myself with my flaws until you get me there.” Aren’t you glad of that? Man. The fourth beast. Interpretation in verse 27 continues. The kingdom, dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom of the whole heaven will be given to the people of the saints of the most high. See, this is not about the four beasts, it’s about the saints, it’s about God, it’s about Jesus Christ.

And it’s It’s the saints prevailing over the mouthy horns. Whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom and he repeats it and all dominion shall serve and obey him, not the saints. There’s some people got this, you know, the church is going to come to the place where people are going to serve us. Folks, we’re only to serve who? Jesus Christ. They just join us serving Christ. Or they are diminished in the earth and the people of God are increased. Hallelujah. Psalms 50:5 tells us who the saints are. Gather my saints together unto me. You see, we’re supposed to gather together. In Genesis, it says unto him shall the gathering of the people we We’re all supposed to assemble together.

We are supposed to pray. We are supposed to worship. We are supposed to join in unity for these things so God can see, “Hey, these people are following my principles.” And he comes by his power and destroys principalities and powers of darkness. And the assembling of the saints was in Genesis. Gather my saints together, Psalms 50. Those that have made a covenant by me with me by sacrifice. See, we come to Christ. He did the sacrifice. We accept his sacrifice on the cross for the cleansing of our sins. We accept his death for our death. We should have been punished. His He was punished for us. We accept that he rose from the grave. And we rise and walk in newness of life.

The Bible plainly tells us this stuff. The There’s no question here. You see, we agree with his sacrifice. And then Romans 12 tells us, present your bodies a living sacrifice holy and acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service. Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. We accept his sacrifice on the cross as payment for our sin, accepting us into his presence, accepting us into the inheritance, and then we offer our lives a living sacrifice. We live for him. Amen. That’s the saints. It isn’t Mother Teresa or Thomas or somebody like that. chunks.short_answer: The power of darkness into His kingdom—bearing fruits of righteousness.

Fruits. Fruits of righteousness. Colossians 1:13, who has delivered us from the power of darkness and has translated us into the kingdom of what? His dear son. What is the point of the scriptures? We possess the kingdom now. We are translated we by the Holy Ghost, by the word of God, we are moved from the kingdom of men and our own kingdom into the kingdom of Jesus Christ, God’s dear son. chunks.short_answer: Take these promises seriously—He speaks to you so you will speak; if you can’t speak, print it.
chunks.text:
His person changed. Why? Cuz this judgment and these promises are serious things. Serious things. And he says, “But I kept the matter in my heart.” I kept the matter in my heart. Now, again, we’ve got to stand for what’s right. Somewhere the church has got to get back to speaking up. If you want to stir America, get a sign or a bumper sticker or a button that says, “I’m a Christian for Bible morality.” If you’re not a Christian, then just be, “I’m an American citizen for Bible morality.” Because the war that’s been going on since the ‘60s is the humanists, the liberals, the atheists, the evolutionists trying to push their morality on the people and get rid of Bible morality.

That’s the little voices that are speaking in our generation. Are you with me? That’s the little horn that are rapping off their mouth against the things of God. And the Christians, we talk amongst each other. But we don’t put a sign out on our lawn. We don’t put a bumper sticker on our car. We don’t get a T-shirt that says, “I oppose homosexual marriage. I’m for a marriage between a man and a woman. That’s the Bible morality. I oppose homosexuality in military service.” I oppose adultery in military service. Am I right? I oppose that homosexuality and adultery is an acceptable lifestyle because they’re both accepted now as an acceptable lifestyle.

A lot of God’s people come to church and have no conviction about shacking up with a man or a woman or homosexuals have no conviction about living with a homosexual. And there should be conviction. We cannot supersede the scriptures. We’ve got to shut up the little voices by speaking up ourselves and accepting their separation, accepting them hating us. Yeah, I’ve had my car painted. I’ve had it scratched. I’ve had glue poured over it. I’ve had my house broken into and salt and stuff poured all over my carpet. Graffiti on the walls. Why? Because I publicly declared what’s right and what’s wrong. And they hated me for it. I’ve been pushed off the road.

A car is just a bunch of guys in it just ran me right off the road. I finally just pulled over, got out of the car before they could get out. Walked toward it, figured out who was the ringleader, walked up right to him and hit him with this question. Yeah, I knew I’d get you. I KNEW I’d GET YOU. YEAH, that’s the time for no, no. Christians use the word. I said, “God bless you. What can I do for you?” The guy started talking. Let me tell you what, before I was done, he hit me with money to give to the ministry. And they were purposed to beat me up. I could give you story after story after story, but it happened because I preached the gospel of Christ.

I preached what God said, they took it out on me. And I would always tell people, “Don’t take it out on me. I’m just telling you what God says. Go beat him up. You know, shoot him. I’m just a mouthpiece. Goodness.” Amen, church? When I made a an abortion brochure graphic, sent it out to the community, they tried to burn down the church. They called and threatened. The reason you’re not experiencing any of these things is that you’re not openly declaring you’re for Bible morality and being specific about it. Can I hear an amen? Oh, we can get in our prayer rooms and pray and think we’re really achieving something, but if you’re really praying, he’s going to tell you get up and do something.

Oh, we can get in the worship and feel the great presence of God. Oh, what not a wonderful service. If he doesn’t activate you to speak against these little horns that are talking against God and his seasons and his laws, his word, then you’ve accomplished nothing in worship. Because you cannot worship him without becoming like him. Because worship is spending time in his presence. When you spend time in the presence of God, you take on his nature, and his nature is to win the world. Amen? But we think in this generation worship is just to feel good. Oh, yeah, I felt the presence. Oh, yeah, we arrived. He comes to speak to get you to speak.

He speaks to you to get you to speak. If you can’t speak, print it. Put it on your T-shirt. I’m a Bible morality believer. If you don’t know how to talk, print it. Carry it around IN A SIGN. DO SOMETHING. AND I GUARANTEE you you’ll find the little voices rising and challenging you and opposing you. And then one day you have victory over them. And other people start listening to you and also get victory.
